name: Power Financial Corporation Preferred Shares (PWF.PR.Z)
summary: Power Financial Corporation is a holding and management company with international reach, supplying asset management and other financial services in Canada and elsewhere. It sells creditor, dental, health, critical illness, disability and life insurance, retirement and investment management, financial planning, reinsurance, investment advisory, and annuity, income and wealth savings products, plus employer-sponsored defined contribution plan services.
